changelog:
### Bug Fix
- Fixed cURL error 35 (SSL/TLS handshake failure) when updating on LocalWP or old OpenSSL servers
- Added 3-layer download fallback: (1) TLS 1.2 + SECLEVEL=1 cipher list, (2) sslverify=false, (3) PHP file_get_contents via stream_context bypassing cURL entirely
- Better error messages showing manual download URL if all attempts fail
